hero.description: My world lives somewhere between code and canvas. By day, I work with logic, but at heart, I create. When I paint, I let go of structure and allow colors and emotions to take over. This collection is the meeting point of the two sides of me — a serene balance between order and imagination.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A collection of moments, sketches, and visions from my painting journey.

about.title: About the Painter
about.paragraph1: I hold bachelor’s degrees in Data Engineering and Mathematics and work full-time as a developer. My life has always been shaped by logic and structure, so stepping into the world of art was something I never expected. I started painting and drawing about two and a half years ago, and it still feels like a wonderful surprise in my life.
about.paragraph2: Outside my tech career, art is where I put the code aside and explore creativity in a more personal way. I’m completely self-taught and love creating oil paintings, portraits, landscapes, and imaginative pieces inspired by curiosity and emotion. Painting has become my way of finding balance and expressing things that words or numbers never quite manage to capture.
